**Definition (Convergence in Norm)**
For a sequence of functions $\{f_n\}_{n\geq 1}$ of a [[normed-space|normed space]] $(V, ||\cdot||)$ then we say that $f_n$ converges with respect to norm $||\cdot||$, written $f_n\stackrel{||\cdot||}{\rightarrow}f$ ($n\rightarrow\infty$), if $$\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}||f_n-f||=0.$$
